decisions.reason: The combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot builds directly on the firm's established automation and formwork knowledge, so its strong absorptive capacity supports learning from early results and improving the product rather than dropping it.
This automatic de-shuttering robot extends the firm's existing de-shuttering expertise, allowing it to assimilate market feedback and refine the product.
The automatic shuttering robot draws on core shuttering and robotics competence, and the firm's R&D experience enables it to absorb new information and enhance the product.

The combined magazining cleaning and plotting machine builds on the firm's established offer as a product line, and its related manufacturing and automation knowledge helps interpret early results and improve the models.

The production analysis software is close to the firm's integrated software and consulting offer, so the firm can apply its existing digital and process knowledge to learn from early results and refine the product.
